name: PT Harum Energy Tbk
summary: PT Harum Energy Tbk, through its subsidiaries, engages in the coal and nickel mining, logistics, and nickel processing and refining activities in Indonesia. It operates through Mining Sectors, Rental and Service Sectors, Nickel Smelter Sector, and Other Sectors segments. The company is involved in the coal and nickel mining, including general survey, exploration, exploitation, and sales activities; and coal shipping and handling, tugboat rental, and road hauling operations, as well as nickel smelting and investing business.
